provenance.coordinateSystem: Shared post-fit display UMAP fitted to the 2,949 observed reference cells on 697 common genes. All coordinates are in the same arbitrary UMAP units.
provenance.sourceIndicesReferTo: Zero-based observed-array indices of the 30 actual source cells for each fold.
provenance.interpretation: Generated samples at each day are populations. Array position does not identify a cell across days or route requests.
provenance.coordinatePrecision: Coordinates rounded to 4 decimals from the archived float32 projection.
